title: 汇丰Joey Chu：日元困局何时破？三大条件缺一不可
speaker: Joey Chu

segments.en: And, you know, we've been stuck between 150, let's call it one, top of 155 to about 160.
segments.zh: 我们一直卡在150，就算151吧，上限155到160左右。

segments.en: Can, will this remain our reality for the foreseeable future, Joey?
segments.zh: Joey，在可预见的未来，这会一直是我们的现实吗？

segments.en: I think we need a few things to get out of this stalemate, right?
segments.zh: 我认为要打破这个僵局，需要几个条件，对吧？

segments.en: I mean, first of all, from the BOJ side, we do need a couple more rate hikes to sort of bring the real interest rates to less negative territory.
segments.zh: 首先，从日本央行方面，我们确实需要再加息几次，让实际利率不那么负。

segments.en: That's the first thing. The second thing is that we probably need a bit more fiscal consolidation, but that's not likely to happen in the next few months because right now, the government is actually debating the opposite, but debating the budget for next year, debating the tax cut for next year.
segments.zh: 这是第一点。第二点是我们可能需要更多的财政整顿，但这在未来几个月不太可能发生，因为目前政府实际上在讨论相反的方向，在讨论明年的预算，讨论明年的减税。

segments.en: So rather than fiscal consolidation, we're still getting the opposite, right?
segments.zh: 所以，我们得到的不是财政整顿，而是相反的情况，对吧？

segments.en: And the third thing I think we need is actually this pivot in capital flows by domestic investors, be it because of risk aversion, or because of higher yields, or because of other reasons, right?
segments.zh: 第三点，我认为我们需要国内市场参与者资本流动的转向，无论是出于风险厌恶、更高的收益率还是其他原因，对吧？

segments.en: And for that, actually, I think next week's GPIF, sort of third quarter type of release, income statements.
segments.zh: 为此，我认为下周GPIF第三季度类型的发布，损益表，会很有趣。

segments.en: That will be interesting because people will be thinking about what is GPIF?
segments.zh: 那会很有趣，因为人们会想，GPIF是什么？

segments.en: What GPIF has been doing the last few months or so?
Yeah, what they've been up to, what have they been selling?
segments.zh: 是的，他们一直在做什么，一直在卖什么？

segments.en: Joey, Southeast Asia, IDR and PHP, nice whole round numbers, 20,000 on the Rupiah, maybe 64, 65 on the past, so do we get there on both?
segments.zh: Joey，东南亚，印尼盾和菲律宾比索，整数关口，印尼盾20,000，比索可能64、65，那么这两个都能达到吗？

segments.en: Well, 20,000 is a little bit far away for a dollar IDR.
segments.zh: 嗯，美元兑印尼盾到20,000还有点远。
